description: This file defines the FinSpaceDataClient class in the Aws inSpaceData namespace, which extends the AwsClient class. It includes method annotations for interacting with the FinSpace Public API, specifying various operations such as creating datasets, managing users and permission groups, and other related actions.

classes.name: FinSpaceDataClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS FinSpace Data API, providing methods for managing datasets, users, permission groups, and other resources related to FinSpace.

methods.name: associateUserToPermissionGroup
methods.description: Associates a user with a permission group.

methods.name: createChangeset
methods.description: Creates a new changeset in FinSpace.

methods.name: disassociateUserFromPermissionGroup
methods.description: Removes a user from a permission group.

methods.name: getChangeset
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific changeset.

methods.name: getDataView
methods.description: Retrieves information about a data view.

methods.name: getExternalDataViewAccessDetails
methods.description: Fetches access details for external data views.

methods.name: getPermissionGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a permission group.

methods.name: listPermissionGroupsByUser
methods.description: Lists permission groups assigned to a user.

methods.name: listUsersByPermissionGroup
methods.description: Lists users within a permission group.
